faqs.question: Can each customer see their own negotiated prices?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build a pricing engine where every trade account is assigned its own price list, volume breaks, and contract rates, so buyers only ever see what was agreed with them. Your public catalog and other accounts' pricing stay completely hidden.

faqs.question: Will the portal enforce credit limits and payment terms?
faqs.answer: It will. At checkout the portal checks each account's credit limit and outstanding balance, applies their net terms, and can block or flag orders that exceed the limit. You decide whether over-limit orders are held for approval or stopped outright.

faqs.question: Can it connect to our existing ERP or accounting system?
faqs.answer: Yes. We sync approved orders, live stock, customer records, and invoices with systems like Odoo, SAP, or your accounting software through their APIs. If you have no ERP yet, the portal can run as your order system of record and connect later.

faqs.question: Is the portal available in Arabic for our GCC buyers?
faqs.answer: Fully. We deliver the buyer-facing portal in both Arabic and English with proper right-to-left layout, so your GCC trade accounts order in the language they prefer. Product names, units, and documents can be bilingual too.

faqs.question: Do we own the portal once it's built?
faqs.answer: Completely. You receive the source code, database, and documentation, and the platform is hosted under your control with no licence per buyer. There is no vendor lock-in — your team can run, extend, and add accounts independently. We start with a free consultation and demo preview before you commit.
